step_by_step_approach: Identify all distinct years present in the results data.
For each year, calculate the total points earned by each driver.
Determine, for each year, the driver with the highest total points.
For each year, calculate the total points earned by each constructor.
Determine, for each year, the constructor with the highest total points.
Add the highest driver total and the highest constructor total for each year.
Rank the years by this combined total in ascending order.
Select the three years with the smallest combined total.
List those three years in order of ascending combined total.
